howto: Pick Pass & Play or a CPU (Easy, Normal or Hard) and press Play.
Tap a column to drop a disc: it falls to the lowest free hole.
Red always goes first, then Yellow.
Four in a row across, down or diagonally wins. A full board is a draw.
tips: The middle column is part of the most possible fours: start there.
Before you drop, check the hole above your disc: could it hand the other player a win?
Build two threats at once; the other player can only block one.
Drop a disc in the gold ⚡ column to earn a hint coin.
Undo takes back your move and the CPU's reply.

controls.keyboard: 1 to 7 drop in a column, or Left/Right then Enter. Z undoes, N starts a new round. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap a column. New Round, Undo and Hint sit under the board.

difficulty: Easy CPU always takes a win but otherwise plays a random column almost half the time; Normal always takes a win, blocks yours and avoids handing you one; Hard searches six moves ahead.

cheats.effect: The CPU naps: you move twice, three times
X-ray: a yellow ring shows the column the CPU wants

features.rules-screen: The title card lists the three rules; Pause > How to play has them too, and Replay tutorial brings the card back
features.ai-difficulty: Easy, Normal and Hard CPU on the title (Hard uses a six-move search)
features.undo: Undo button (or Z) takes back your last move and the CPU's reply; in Pass & Play one move at a time
features.results: Win, lose or draw card with the score, streak and totals; the winning four glow and a line is drawn through them
